Also, any terms in the glossaries or dictionaries provided, and any section titles (including appendices) that are denoted alphabetically will follow this order [or the more expanded version of the alphabet that English uses?].
3) The reader should note that a few letters are missing from the Lojbanic alphabet and some letters are added. These changes will be covered in more detail shortly.
